# Bonooru conformance vectors (AD-14). Format: vectors/README.md.
# Generated by an independent implementation and reviewed by hand;
# a wire change edits these files first.
#
# constants.txt: every wire constant, NAME: big-endian hex number
# (the OCB_ prefix of the C macro is dropped). Both directions are checked.
proto_version: 01

# Protocol version (AD-7)
PROTO_VERSION: 01

# Message types (AD-3)
MSG_HELLO: 01
MSG_SET_STATE: 02
MSG_QUEUE_EVENT: 03
MSG_START: 04
MSG_STOP: 05
MSG_PING: 06
MSG_HEARTBEAT: 40
MSG_INFO: 81
MSG_STATUS: 83
MSG_ACK: 84
MSG_NAK: 85
MSG_EVENT: 86

# Type ranges per direction (AD-3)
TYPE_APP_MIN: 01
TYPE_APP_MAX: 3f
TYPE_BRIDGE_MIN: 40
TYPE_BRIDGE_MAX: 7f
TYPE_CTRL_MIN: 80
TYPE_CTRL_MAX: ff

# NAK reasons (AD-6): transport 01..0f, semantic 10..7f
NAK_CRC: 01
NAK_SEQ: 02
NAK_FULL: 03
NAK_VERSION: 10
NAK_BUSY: 11
NAK_ORDER: 12
NAK_BAD_STATE: 13
NAK_UNKNOWN_TYPE: 14
NAK_NO_LINK: 15
NAK_NOT_READY: 16
NAK_ABORTED: 17
NAK_TRANSPORT_MIN: 01
NAK_TRANSPORT_MAX: 0f
NAK_SEMANTIC_MIN: 10
NAK_SEMANTIC_MAX: 7f

# EVENT codes (AD-5, AD-8); NONE only in STATUS.last_event
EVT_NONE: 00
EVT_PLAYBACK_DONE: 01
EVT_LINK_LOST: 02
EVT_LATE: 03
EVT_UNDERRUN: 04
EVT_USB_SUSPENDED: 05

# Controller modes (AD-8)
MODE_IDLE: 00
MODE_DIRECT: 01
MODE_PLAYING: 02

# HID profile ids (INFO.hid_profile)
HID_PROFILE_UNKNOWN: 00
HID_PROFILE_P1: 01
HID_PROFILE_P2: 02
HID_PROFILE_P3: 03

# Flag bits (AD-4, AD-8, AD-19)
HB_FLAG_DTR: 01
STATUS_LINK_OK: 01
STATUS_CONSOLE_READY: 02
STATUS_RESERVED_MASK: fc
STATE_FLAG_END: 01
STATE_RESERVED_MASK: fe

# Buttons, canonical P1 bit order (AD-10)
BTN_Y: 0001
BTN_B: 0002
BTN_A: 0004
BTN_X: 0008
BTN_L: 0010
BTN_R: 0020
BTN_ZL: 0040

BTN_PLUS: 0200
BTN_L3: 0400
BTN_R3: 0800
BTN_HOME: 1000
BTN_CAPTURE: 2000

# Hat, clockwise from up; 8 = neutral (AD-10)
HAT_UP: 00
HAT_UP_RIGHT: 01
HAT_RIGHT: 02
HAT_DOWN_RIGHT: 03
HAT_DOWN: 04
HAT_DOWN_LEFT: 05
HAT_LEFT: 06
HAT_UP_LEFT: 07
HAT_NEUTRAL: 08
STICK_CENTER: 80

# Sizes (D5): body <= 255, raw = 3 + body + 2, COBS adds ceil(n / 254)
STATE_SIZE: 08
MAX_BODY: ff
MIN_RAW_FRAME: 05
MAX_RAW_FRAME: 0104
MAX_ENCODED_FRAME: 0106
MAX_WIRE_FRAME: 0107
FRAME_DELIMITER: 00
FRAME_HEADER_SIZE: 03
FRAME_CRC_SIZE: 02

# Body lengths (v1 sizes; D10 length rules)
BODY_LEN_HELLO: 01
BODY_LEN_INFO: 0e

BODY_LEN_QUEUE_EVENT: 0c
BODY_LEN_START: 04
BODY_LEN_STOP: 00
BODY_LEN_PING: 00
BODY_LEN_HEARTBEAT: 04
BODY_LEN_STATUS: 0b
BODY_LEN_ACK: 01
BODY_LEN_NAK: 03
BODY_LEN_EVENT: 01

# CRC-16/CCITT-FALSE (RevEng CRC-16/IBM-3740), sent little-endian
CRC16_POLY: 1021
CRC16_INIT: ffff
CRC16_CHECK: 29b1

# Link timing (D6); units in the name
LINK_BAUD: 070800
